meta.title: Robustness at Scale: re-estimated regressions
meta.tagline: What the re-estimation agent got when it ran the deposited code for every regression of an article: a value per withheld cell, the N achieved, or why it could not.
meta.description: One entry per regression the pipeline's re-estimation answered for (`reproduce/<artid>.result.json`): status, method, the reason for a failure, the achieved sample size, the do-file and command that produced it, and one reproduced value per cell of the blinded grid, positioned by row index. Produced OUTSIDE Metalens by a sandboxed agent driving Stata over the replication package; this preset is the schema the results are imported into. The robustness workflow's grade step reads these against the regression tables of the same paper.
